scope: Independent A2 review of 67 polynomial division/remainder sources; queue 26 uses only current post-D input.

activeVocabularyReview.finding: The ACTIVE vocabulary contains cross-domain near matches but no exact polynomial division/remainder template. Direct substitution, proposition parameter, limit reconstruction, derivative structural determination, and binomial-term templates omit or change the defining remainder/factor-division decision rule.

clusterDefinitions.boundedCandidateSkeleton: Write the new remainder as the known lower-divisor remainder plus a multiple of that divisor within the degree bound; evaluate at an added factor root to fix the remaining coefficient.
clusterDefinitions.mergeRationale: Both extend a known remainder modulo a repeated linear factor by one extra distinct factor, then use its root to determine the one remaining coefficient.
clusterDefinitions.activeTemplateCheckReason: No exact ACTIVE equivalent; supplied templates contain no polynomial remainder-extension skeleton.

clusterDefinitions.boundedCandidateSkeleton: Write each relevant division identity; enforce quotient/remainder degree bounds and shared quotient, remainder, or value constraints; solve the coupled polynomial coefficients and evaluate.
clusterDefinitions.mergeRationale: Each combines linked quotient/remainder statements, equality constraints, or degree bounds to determine polynomial pieces; the arrangement of identities is a variation.
clusterDefinitions.activeTemplateCheckReason: No exact ACTIVE template models coupled polynomial division identities.

clusterDefinitions.boundedCandidateSkeleton: Write P=DQ+R; evaluate at the divisor root to get R or at another input to isolate a quotient value; combine values from one or more division identities.
clusterDefinitions.mergeRationale: Each evaluates one or more stated division identities at selected inputs to extract dividend, quotient, or remainder values; linked data and cancellation are variations.
clusterDefinitions.activeTemplateCheckReason: No exact ACTIVE equivalent. TPL_FUNCTION_VALUE_DIRECT does not encode division identities or isolate quotient/remainder components.

clusterDefinitions.boundedCandidateSkeleton: Translate each candidate linear factor to its root; evaluate the polynomial at that root; accept or reject the factor (or common factor) by zero/nonzero.
clusterDefinitions.mergeRationale: Both test candidate linear factors by evaluating at their roots; common-factor versus nonfactor output is a variation.
clusterDefinitions.activeTemplateCheckReason: No exact ACTIVE equivalent. Active divisibility templates concern number-set inclusion or proof by contraposition, not polynomial factor tests.

clusterDefinitions.boundedCandidateSkeleton: Use a factor or divisor identity to derive a power relation modulo the divisor; reduce high powers or the quotient form to a low-degree expression; evaluate the requested value.
clusterDefinitions.mergeRationale: Both exploit a divisor identity to reduce or count high-power terms; exponent and requested quotient/remainder value are variations.
clusterDefinitions.activeTemplateCheckReason: No exact ACTIVE equivalent; the polynomial-limit reconstruction template has a different limit-driven structure.

clusterDefinitions.boundedCandidateSkeleton: Express the integer base as a variable congruent to a simple root determined by the modulus; evaluate there; verify the residue range.
clusterDefinitions.mergeRationale: Both reduce a numerical remainder question to evaluating the corresponding polynomial at the base residue modulo the integer divisor.
clusterDefinitions.activeTemplateCheckReason: No exact ACTIVE equivalent. Number-divisibility templates concern set relations or proof, not evaluation at a polynomial residue.

clusterDefinitions.boundedCandidateSkeleton: For x−a, evaluate P(a) to obtain the constant remainder.
clusterDefinitions.mergeRationale: All items ask for a constant remainder after one linear division; one evaluation at the divisor root decides it. Root and coefficient changes do not create new keys.
clusterDefinitions.activeTemplateCheckReason: No exact ACTIVE equivalent. TPL_FUNCTION_VALUE_DIRECT is generic function-value substitution under a different parent and omits the divisor-root-to-remainder relation.

clusterDefinitions.boundedCandidateSkeleton: Translate a linear-divisor remainder to P(a)=r; combine with the polynomial form or factor constraints to solve a coefficient, then evaluate any requested output.
clusterDefinitions.mergeRationale: Each uses a linear-divisor remainder as a point-value constraint that fixes a polynomial parameter; transformations and later target evaluation are variations.
clusterDefinitions.activeTemplateCheckReason: No exact ACTIVE equivalent. TPL_PROPOSITION_DIRECT_SUBSTITUTION_PARAMETER is generic proposition parameterization and lacks polynomial remainder conditions.

clusterDefinitions.boundedCandidateSkeleton: Convert each linear-factor or remainder condition to P(r)=rValue; solve the coefficient equations; evaluate or factor only as needed for the requested expression.
clusterDefinitions.mergeRationale: All reduce factor/remainder conditions to point-value equations and use them to determine coefficients or a requested combination. Zero values, nonzero remainders, and equation count are variations.
clusterDefinitions.activeTemplateCheckReason: No exact ACTIVE equivalent. TPL_STRUCTURAL_FUNCTION_DETERMINE belongs to derivative-based function determination; TPL_LIMIT_POLYNOMIAL_RECONSTRUCTION requires limit conditions.

clusterDefinitions.boundedCandidateSkeleton: Perform or interpret the division recurrence, cancel leading terms until the residual degree is below the divisor, and read quotient and remainder; recover or rescale synthetic-table rows as needed.
clusterDefinitions.mergeRationale: All use long division or the equivalent synthetic-division recurrence to obtain, inspect, or reconstruct quotient/remainder data. Display format, nonmonic scaling, and later quotient evaluation are variations.
clusterDefinitions.activeTemplateCheckReason: No exact ACTIVE polynomial division algorithm template.

clusterDefinitions.boundedCandidateSkeleton: Evaluate a product condition at the divisor root; convert it to zero-product or squared-value branches; use remaining polynomial constraints or the objective to select the result.
clusterDefinitions.mergeRationale: Both evaluate a product at a linear-divisor root, derive multiple factor-value branches, and use remaining conditions or the objective to select among them.
clusterDefinitions.activeTemplateCheckReason: No exact ACTIVE equivalent; generic proposition case-proof templates do not model polynomial product remainders or factor-root branches.

clusterDefinitions.boundedCandidateSkeleton: At a root shared by the target divisor and a supplied divisor, replace the target remainder value by the dividend value and transfer the supplied remainder there.
clusterDefinitions.mergeRationale: Both avoid constructing the entire target remainder because the requested evaluation lies at a divisor root shared with a supplied remainder condition.
clusterDefinitions.activeTemplateCheckReason: No exact ACTIVE equivalent. Direct function evaluation does not capture transfer from a shared divisor root.

clusterDefinitions.boundedCandidateSkeleton: Represent the remainder below divisor degree; transfer known dividend values to divisor roots; solve the bounded-degree remainder from those values and evaluate or use it.
clusterDefinitions.mergeRationale: Each recovers a bounded-degree remainder from values at distinct divisor roots. Source values may come from a lower remainder, linked division, an identity, equal-remainder data, or a reconstructed dividend.
clusterDefinitions.activeTemplateCheckReason: No exact ACTIVE equivalent. Generic function-value substitution lacks remainder degree/interpolation logic; limit reconstruction uses different conditions.

clusterDefinitions.boundedCandidateSkeleton: Apply the factor theorem at a root, divide out one linear factor, impose the same root on the quotient for the next multiplicity, then solve remaining coefficients and evaluate.
clusterDefinitions.mergeRationale: Each imposes square divisibility by a linear factor and uses repeated root testing or its equivalent quotient form; coefficient/exponent changes are variations.
clusterDefinitions.activeTemplateCheckReason: No exact ACTIVE equivalent. TPL_STRUCTURAL_FUNCTION_DETERMINE includes multiplicity only in a derivative-family structure, not this polynomial division procedure.

clusterDefinitions.boundedCandidateSkeleton: Set t=x−r and express the identity in descending powers of t by expansion or successive synthetic division; read the shifted-basis coefficients and combine them as requested.
clusterDefinitions.mergeRationale: Both determine coefficients after expressing a cubic in powers of x−r; shift values and requested coefficient combinations are incidental. Queue 98 remains HOLD for a source wording mismatch.
clusterDefinitions.activeTemplateCheckReason: No exact ACTIVE equivalent. TPL_BINOMIAL_TERM_COEFFICIENT targets binomial-theorem terms, not shifted-basis coefficients.
